name: Tooltip
intent: Give a trigger element a short, non-interactive, hover/focus-revealed explanation without requiring it to carry its own accessible name.

figmaSource.note: Figma's tooltip-primitive frame has no placement/positioning variant at all (only truncate and showTooltip) - the topCenter default and viewport-fit fallback are entirely a code-side decision, delegated to Popup rather than modeled in Tooltip's own Figma source.

useCases: Clarifying an icon-only control whose meaning isn't obvious from its accessible name alone
Explaining why a control is disabled
Short supplemental context that isn't essential to completing the task
antiPatterns: Essential information the user needs to complete a task
The only accessible name for a control
Interactive content (buttons, links, form controls) inside the tooltip

anatomy.name: trigger
anatomy.description: The single child element Tooltip wraps. Cloned to receive pointer/focus handlers and aria-describedby.

anatomy.name: disabled-pointer-wrapper
anatomy.description: A non-focusable span wrapping a disabled native trigger, so hover still works without creating an extra tab stop.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Rendered through Popup (unstyled, alignment=topCenter, role=tooltip) - Popup owns positioning/portal/animation, Tooltip owns its own visual skin.

content.description: No tooltip behavior is attached at all when this is empty (null, undefined, or a blank string).

children.description: A single trigger element - cloned to add pointer/focus handlers and aria-describedby.

truncate.description: Single ellipsized line (420px max) vs. wrapped text (240px max before wrapping).

disabled.description: Suppresses the tooltip entirely - not just visually hidden.

delay.description: Milliseconds of hover/focus before the tooltip appears.

className.description: Composes with the tooltip content element's class list.

tokens.note: Horizontal padding is --measurement-6 (6px), a raw measurement rather than a semantic spacing token - Figma's own value doesn't land on the 4/8/12/16px spacing scale. Positioning/z-index/animation tokens (--spacing-sm gap, --fade-quick) now live in Popup, not here - see popup.contract.json.

behaviorRules: Owns trigger behavior via composition (hover, focus, blur, pointer leave, Escape).
Supports disabled native controls with a non-focusable pointer wrapper.
Does not render or attach behavior when content is absent.
Skips internal behavior when consumer handlers prevent default.
Renders through Popup with unstyled set - Popup owns positioning, the portal, and the mount animation; Tooltip owns its own visual skin.
Always requests Popup's topCenter alignment - no placement prop; Popup's own viewport-fit fallback (topCenter -> bottomCenter -> the remaining four) handles the rest.
Sets manageTriggerAria={false} on Popup - Tooltip's own aria-describedby is the correct ARIA pattern here, not Popup's disclosure-widget aria-expanded/aria-controls.

Sets closeOnEscape={false} and closeOnOutsideClick={false} on Popup - Tooltip's own hover/focus/blur/Escape-on-trigger dismissal predates Popup and has different semantics than a generic dismissible popup.
compositionRules: Give the trigger its own accessible name, independent of the tooltip content.
Use external composition (IconButton/ToggleIconButton's own tooltip={false}) when the tooltip message should differ from the accessible name.
contentRules: Tooltip content must not replace the trigger's accessible name.
themeRules: Visible with sufficient contrast on both light and dark surfaces.
do: Give the trigger its own accessible name, independent of the tooltip content.
Let a disabled control still explain itself via Tooltip.
dont: Do not rely on tooltip content as the only description of what a control does.
Do not put content in a tooltip that the user needs in order to proceed - use visible UI instead.
Do not expect a placement prop - positioning is Popup's fallback, not manual per-instance control.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders the trigger child; attaches no behavior when content is empty.
Shows on hover (after delay) and keyboard focus; hides on pointer leave, blur, and Escape.
Sets role=tooltip and wires aria-describedby only while visible, preserving any existing value.
Supports disabled native controls via a non-focusable pointer wrapper with no extra tab stop.
Preserves consumer event handlers and honors preventDefault().
Always resolves to topCenter alignment unless the viewport requires Popup's fallback.
knownLimitations: No fade-out on hide - React removes the node immediately, so exit is instant.
The trigger-to-tooltip gap is Popup's fixed 8px (--spacing-sm), not Tooltip's previous 4px (--spacing-xs) - accepted as part of centralizing positioning in Popup.
futureEnhancements: A matching fade-out, which would require deferring unmount until the animation finishes.
